title: Professional Mulch Installation vs. DIY: What Chicago Homeowners Should Know
intro: As a Chicago homeowner, you understand the unique challenges and opportunities our vibrant city's climate presents for your landscape. From the harsh freezes of winter to the scorching heat and humidity of summer, your garden beds and foundation plantings require consistent care to thrive. At the heart of a healthy, beautiful landscape lies one unsung hero: mulch. But when it comes to applying this essential ground cover, many homeowners face a critical decision: should you tackle the arduous task yourself, or invest in professional mulch installation? This article delves into the nuances of mulch blowing vs spreading, providing expert insights to help you make the best choice for your Chicago property, ensuring a landscape that not only survives but truly flourishes.
